title: Timeline: frame sound indicator missing — no visual cue when keyframe has sound attached
description: FrameCell renders keyframe dots, label tags, and script 'a' icons, but does NOT show a sound-wave icon when frame.sound is set. Real Flash 8 shows a small sound icon on keyframes with sounds. Fix: in FrameCell or frame rendering, check if the frame has a sound property and render a small indicator (e.g. a musical note or 'S' icon) next to the keyframe dot.
